notes.title: Localization
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25427086/be35a6d65123e7218ef0ffaa55601cc92ffc4a9b.png[/img]

By default, the language will be defined depending on your system configuration. You can change it at anytime by pressing the bottom green button.

Languages Available:

- English
- French
- Chinese Traditional
- Chinese Simplified
